name: monkey-maestro
description: Linear-first project orchestration with deterministic readiness, parallel Superset dispatch, and issue-scoped recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate Linear dependency graphs through Superset agents
interface.longDescription: Monkey Maestro uses live Linear project membership, status types, and blockedBy links as its only scheduling authority. Each invocation hydrates one disposable graph cache, checks Superset only for selected non-terminal issues, dispatches independent workers with all-settled failure isolation, monitors exact active terminals, and exits immediately when idle. Runtime reconciliation remains optional and never owns the graph.
defaultPrompt: Inspect this Linear project URL read-only and report its Maestro state.
Use Monkey Maestro to start project execution for this verified Linear project.
Use Monkey Maestro to orchestrate this active Linear project and monitor all ready work.
Use Monkey Maestro to audit or repair Superset runtime correlation without changing the Linear graph.
Use Monkey Maestro to spawn or force one task-linked Superset workspace from live Linear state.
Use Monkey Maestro to stop future project dispatches without terminating active work.
